name: The Everyday Essential
tagline: Connect CJdropshipping in .env, research a product, approve it, and this storefront updates automatically.
description: This is the launch placeholder. From the admin control room, run recent product research and approve a candidate. buyanything will search CJdropshipping, import a matching supplier product and fulfillment identifiers, create polished storefront copy, and make it ready for Stripe checkout.
